headline: Earnings surge on an FX swing as outlook is raised again
summary_short: American Tower reported Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS of $1.86, up 138.5% y/y (boosted by a swing to FX gains) and about 1.1% q/q; total revenue rose 4.7% to $2,749M and AFFO per share grew 4.2% to $2.71, and the company raised its full-year 2026 outlook for the second time this year.
summary_long: Total revenue rose 4.7% y/y to $2,749M (property revenue +6.3% to $2,688M) on robust leasing demand across the tower portfolio and record CoreSite data-center leasing. Net income jumped 133.2% to $888M, driven mainly by a $42.1M FX gain versus a $484.0M FX loss a year earlier rather than core operations. Adjusted EBITDA grew 3.2% to $1,808M and AFFO per share rose 4.2% to $2.71. Management raised full-year 2026 guidance for the second time this year, lifting property revenue, Adjusted EBITDA, AFFO and AFFO/share midpoints on favorable FX, Data Center outperformance, and one-time expense benefits. Net leverage was 4.9x; liquidity totaled $9.9B ($1.76B cash) against $37.19B total debt.
